== Biography ==
Alexander was christened 25 Nov 1814 to parents [[Glasgow-1529|George Glasgow (abt.1769-)]] and [[Robertson-20324|Lilias (Robertson) Glasgow (abt.1777-)]]<ref>"Scotland Births and Baptisms, 1564-1950", database, FamilySearch (https://familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ45-TJF : 12 February 2020), Alexander Glasgow, 1814. [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ45-TJF familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:VQ45-TJF]</ref>

Alexander Glasgow's life is documented through a series of census records spanning two decades in the mid-19th century. These records offer insights into his occupation, family dynamics, and residency in Midlothian, Scotland.

=== 1851 Census ===

The 1851 Census reveals Alexander Glasgow residing at Wellington Place, Midlothian. His profession is listed as a house joiner. He is recorded living with his wife, Ann, and their children: George, Lillias, and Margaret.

'''Source:''' ''"1851 Scotland Census,"'' database, [https://search.ancestry.co.uk/cgi-bin/sse.dll?dbid=1076&h=2926792&indiv=try&o_vc=Record:OtherRecord&rhSource=60143 1851 Census]: Alexander Glasgow, House Joiner, at Wellington Place, Midlothian with wife Ann and children George, Lillias, Margaret. Parish: Midlothian; citing ED, Page, Household schedule number, Line, Roll, Registration district.

=== 1861 Census ===

In 1861, Alexander Glasgow, now aged 45, is found in Newton, Midlothian. He continues his work as a joiner, living with his wife, Ann, and their son, John B Glasgow.

'''Source:''' ''"1861 Scotland Census,"'' database, [https://search.ancestry.co.uk/cgi-bin/sse.dll?indiv=1&dbid=1080&h=1366518&tid=&pid=&queryId=927aa2332fae9cfff9fe1a66b5b037c7&usePUB=true&_phsrc=dfz35&_phstart=successSource 1861 Census]: Alexander Glasgow, Joiner, in Midlothian, Newton with wife Ann and son John B. Glasgow. Parish: Newton; citing ED, Page, Household schedule number, Line, Roll, Registration district.

=== 1871 Census ===

By 1871, Alexander, aged 56, heads a household in East Millerhill, Newton, Midlothian. He is a joiner, with his wife Ann, aged 57, who originates from Libberton, Midlothian, Scotland.

'''Source:''' ''"1871 England, Wales & Scotland Census,"'' database, [https://search.ancestry.co.uk/cgi-bin/sse.dll?dbid=1104&h=3333597&indiv=try&o_vc=Record:OtherRecord&rhSource=60143 1871 Census]: Alexander Glasgow, Joiner, at East Millerhill, Newton, Midlothian with wife Ann. Parish: Newton; citing ED, Page, Household schedule number, Line, Roll, Registration district.
